description: The LEADS a LinkedIn lead gen form collected — every response with its answers keyed by field (firstName, lastName, email, company, …), the campaign and creative that produced it, the consents ticked, and whether it was a test lead. Newest first. Filter by formId, a since/until window (ISO date or epoch ms — LinkedIn takes epoch), or testLeadsOnly. THIS IS PERSONAL DATA: show it to the user, hand it to the CRM they name, never repeat it into a post or an unrelated tool. Pass start for the next page. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: read forms owned by an AD ACCOUNT instead of a Page

leadType.description: defaults by owner: SPONSORED for an ad account, COMPANY (organic Page form) for a Page; EVENT for event forms. LinkedIn refuses SPONSORED on a Page owner

pageId.description: the company Page that owns the form — from list_linkedin_pages; omit when one Page is shared

name: list_linkedin_leads
title: List LinkedIn leads (form responses)
